notable_absence.finding: The page describes waitUntilReady(), DNS-SRV, and Alternate Addresses in detail as ways of establishing and maintaining a healthy connection, but never cross-references sdk:ping/sdk:diagnostics (health-check.md, in this same batch) as the way to observe connection state after bootstrap - the two pages' subject matter overlaps (both are about the client's live relationship with the cluster) but neither links to the other.

cross_product_finding: Cloud Native Gateway is documented as spanning three separately-versioned products at once: 'introduced in Java SDK 3.5 and Couchbase Autonomous Operator 2.6.1', and 'in this case, only available in the Server running on Kubernetes or OpenShift, with a recent version of Couchbase Autonomous Operator' - meaning the couchbase2:// protocol is gated on minimum versions of the SDK, the Operator, AND a Kubernetes/OpenShift-hosted Server simultaneously, not on the SDK version alone.
